title: Scripture and Discipleship
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: Scripture and discipleship teaches that God’s Word forms followers of Jesus who learn, obey, grow, endure, and teach others. Discipleship is not personality-driven or trend-driven; it is Word-shaped life under Christ.
summary: Scripture and discipleship teaches that God’s Word forms followers of Jesus who learn, obey, grow, endure, and teach others. Discipleship is not personality-driven or trend-driven; it is Word-shaped life under Christ.
christFocus: Jesus commands His disciples to make disciples by baptizing and teaching obedience to all He commanded. Scripture shows believers who Christ is, what He teaches, and how His followers are to walk with Him.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Disciples are learners and followers of Jesus. Scripture is central to discipleship because it reveals Christ, teaches truth, corrects sin, trains in righteousness, and equips believers for good works.

Jesus said that those who abide in His word are truly His disciples. Discipleship is therefore more than religious activity or emotional commitment. It involves remaining in Christ’s teaching and being shaped by His truth.

The Word of Christ is to dwell richly among God’s people. Discipleship happens as believers teach, admonish, sing, encourage, obey, serve, and grow together under Scripture.

Sound doctrine must be taught because discipleship requires truth. Believers cannot grow into maturity on shallow encouragement alone. They need the whole Word applied to the whole life.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many people think discipleship means attending events, following a personality, joining a program, or improving habits. Those may have a place, but discipleship without Scripture loses its center.

This doctrine keeps ministry from becoming entertainment, self-help, or dependence on leaders. God’s people are formed as followers of Jesus through the Word, the Spirit, the church, obedience, and persevering faith.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Let Scripture shape your discipleship. Stay in the words of Jesus, learn sound doctrine, obey what God teaches, and help others follow Christ through the Word. Do not measure discipleship only by activity; look for growing faith, repentance, love, obedience, endurance, and Christlike character.
